method: Single current/frozen child executions with the same monitored DRIVER; text and four export template pairs use equivalent input bytes/state. Facts share the same pin/plain control but A current batch additionally includes two bounded pollution controls, so facts timers are different whole-batch workloads. Observe times separately from product gold equality. No claim about unmonitored native performance or statistical stability; no repeated measurement.
